_note: Деталь 3 — Zone 3 cathode flange (01_01 §1 + 02_02 §1.2). Flange Ø25 frozen (HW.8 axial freeze). Shank Ø9 + thickness 3 = PLACEHOLDER (HW.8 bench). Barbs reuse the §4.3 Zone-3 lock (dir −1). Bayonet lugs mate the Радом (Деталь 4, фаза 2). Cathode catalytic = side/perimeter (O₂); pogo = top face (Hard Gold coating, not geometry).
name: cathode_flange

notes.process: SLM/DMLS or EBM. The 'precision less critical' allowance of 01_02 1.7 applies to the FLANGE DISC only (flat O25 face, roughness = ECSA advantage) — it does NOT extend to the bus channel, which is the part's primary datum and is machined after printing (see post-process). Reading it part-wide licenses an as-printed bore and contradicts note 5. HIP is OPTIONAL on this part and that is a CANON CLAUSE, not an omission (01_02 1.7 conclusion table): Zone 1, the gyroid anode, carries a MANDATORY HIP; this Zone-3 flange does not, and the stated ground is that an EBM hot build platform relieves the residual stress HIP exists to remove. ATTENTION - that ground covers the EBM branch only, and canon does not say what follows if you print this part on a laser machine. So state which process you would use and whether you HIP it; we are ASKING here, not specifying, and silence is not consent either way (00_07 HW.23).
notes.post_process: selective Hard-Gold ENIG on central GND pad + outer pogo ring (02_02 1.2, Ti-Au galvanic-trap fix); build tip-down (01_02 1.6) | bus channel O1.35: MACHINE after printing to the tolerance block (primary datum, 0.05 concentricity/runout) - NOT as-printed. The nominal was OPENED 1.30 -> 1.35 by verdict (00_07 HW.34, 2026-09-11) so the rod+liner stack (1.0 + 2x0.15 = 1.30) enters with a real 50 um diametral clearance instead of the zero the arithmetic used to allow; the change rides this EXISTING machining operation, it does not add one. ATTENTION - the DIAMETRAL TOLERANCE BAND on this bore is NOT SPECIFIED anywhere in canon and is not derivable: 50 um may fall inside the tolerance of the extruded PEEK tube itself, whose supplier holds ID/OD and not the wall we froze. It is a question to the vendor (00_07 HW.34), so quote your achievable band rather than reading a default into the blank
notes.surface_finish: PER-SURFACE, not one finish for the whole part (01_02 1.3): catalytic side/perimeter = EAAE dual-scale micro Sa 0.5-5 um + nano Sv 50-500 nm (Step 4, Laccase/ZIF ECSA) - NO PEP and NO H2O2 passivation on that face (Steps 6-7); outer jacket = PEP smoothing to Ra 0.4 um max (Step 7) before ZnO-Ta PEO; pogo top face = MASKED during EAAE, then SELECTIVE Hard-Gold ENIG on the central GND pad + outer pogo ring only, PEEK isolation ring between them left bare (02_02 1.2). Sand-blasting is admissible on THIS part (Zone 3, line-of-sight geometry, Step 3), unlike the Zone-1 gyroid.
notes.coating_restriction: Catalytic face (Laccase + ZIF-nanozyme + PTFE-GDL): ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic (Zn-HAp/chitosan) ALL FORBIDDEN - bare Ti only, any dielectric blocks DET. Outer jacket: ZnO-Ta + 8-HQ allowed. NOT on PEEK. (01_02 3.6)
notes.lattice_spec: Not applicable - solid flange disc with a central bus channel, no lattice. (The lattice lives in the Zone-1 anode this part mates to, cem/anchor_zone1.*.json)
notes.inspection: SEM of the catalytic face BEFORE shipment (01_02 1.5, factory obligation): x5,000 for micro-roughness (report the AREAL Sa of the 01_02 1.2 acceptance row, not a profile Ra) and x50,000 for nano-pores Sv - if nano-pores are not visible at x50,000 the etch is insufficient and EAAE (01_02 1.3 Step 4) is repeated; the x500 frame of 01_02 1.5 is for gyroid macro-pores and has no subject on this part. Bus channel: MACHINED after printing to the tolerance block (primary datum, 0.05 concentricity/runout) and it must accept the 0.15 mm structural liner (01_01 1.4) - an as-printed bore fails this part. Its own diametral band is listed as bore_dia with BOTH limits NOT SPECIFIED: that blank is the open vendor question of 00_07 HW.34, not a licence to accept any bore that passes concentricity. PEP is confined to the outer jacket: measure Ra <= 0.4 um THERE and nowhere else, because PEP on the catalytic face would cut away exactly the ECSA Step 4 just created (01_02 1.3 Step 7). Selective Hard-Gold ENIG on the central GND pad and outer pogo ring only, PEEK isolation ring left bare (02_02 1.2). ATTENTION: the batch-level SEM ACCEPTANCE CRITERION - what morphology passes, as opposed to which frames to shoot - does not exist in canon yet and is an open leg (00_07 HW.1); do not read its absence as a pass. ANODE-TO-CATHODE RESISTANCE, added 2026-09-12: measure it on the ASSEMBLED anchor before shipment. The bus rod runs up this channel isolated by a 0.15 mm PEEK liner, and a missing or wear-through liner shorts anode to cathode (~0.5 V) - that is a NODE failure, not a degradation, and no direct control on a missing tube exists otherwise (00_07 HW.34, FMEA row #22 carries D=8 for exactly this reason). Cheapest mitigation in the whole register and it belongs on THIS part's acceptance sheet, because the channel is here
